globalProperty.description: The name of the user property read by allowedlocation_allowedLocationFilter, its value is expected to be a comma separated list of location uuids, location names are also accepted. Note that this filter is ANDed with datafilter's own datafilter_locationFilter when both are enabled, so set datafilter_locationFilter.disabled to true on the datafilter module to drive location access from this property alone instead of from datafilter's datafilter_entity_basis_map table.

When the value is set to true, the child locations of each location listed in the user property are accessible too, at all levels of nesting. This matches how the bases assigned in datafilter's datafilter_entity_basis_map table are expanded, so a user can be granted a district and get every facility beneath it.

When the value is true, which is the default, a user with no value for the user property is not restricted at all, so installing this module does not change what existing users can see until they are actually given the property. Set it to false once every user has one, to make the filter fail closed, at which point a user without the property is granted access to no locations at all and has nothing to pick from at login.
